sub_rule_text: Verify borrower's annual income through tax returns and W2 forms for the past 2 years.
Maintain a debt-to-income ratio below 43% for qualified mortgages.
Obtain independent property appraisal from certified appraiser.
Compare property value with similar properties sold in the past 6 months.
Ensure valuation report includes property condition assessment and photographs.
Monitor loan payments and flag any missed payments within 30 days.
Establish clear exit strategy including refinancing or sale timeline.
Review and update risk assessment annually or upon material changes.
